versions.content: Configuration "Notification for Wake-up by Bus" The FlexRay Transceiver Driver shall support the compile time configuration of one notification to a higher layer for change notification for "wake-up by bus" events. One wake-up by bus event notification shall be supported to one higher layer. If a transceiver device does not support "wake-up by bus", this notification is never called for this bus. Efficient coupling between FlexRay Transceiver Driver and higher layer.
